propositions: Production Python under src/rebar exhibits 69 C901 over-threshold functions (max 45); raw Ruff exits 1 because findings exist and cannot gate every change.
A shrink-only baseline wrapper (--check mode) accepts only debt reductions and removals; --update-stale guarded maintenance rewrites ceilings atomically and refuses new/increased complexity.

Baseline JSON schema (schema_version 1, sorted ceilings keyed by repo-relative-POSIX-path::AST-qualified-symbol, integer ceilings > 15) rejects duplicates, unknown fields, and malformed data; symbol identity disambiguates nested/async functions by ancestry.

make lint integrates the wrapper check over src/rebar while retaining existing Ruff and format checks over src and tests; --exit-zero on both the wrapper and Ruff census normalize return codes so JSON findings can be consumed without treating debt as scanner failure.

Mutually exclusive counters (active, new, increased, stale) classify findings relative to baseline; new or increased debt causes wrapper exit 1, stale improvements exit 0, and scanner failures (missing Ruff, RC≥2, invalid JSON, duplicate current keys) exit nonzero.
The complexity ratchet enforces threshold 15 on production control flow only; test-helper complexity is out of scope and the asymmetry is explicit rather than accidental.
